hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 < r, using the existing proof in the positive case. Otherwise, Metric.nonneg_of_mem_closedBall hx gives 0 ≤ r, hence r = 0. By Metric.closedBall_zero, hx and hy give x = c and y = c, so both sides simplify to zero. Negative radii are excluded by hx. This also handles empty ι and trivial F.
